text:
andrew: seeing p99 token latency creep on dedicated-usw1-s20. single tenant looks responsible — sustained nic tail and kvcache regen. anyone around to triage?

priya: can you paste the metrics and slice id?

andrew: slice=dedicated-usw1-s20. quick metrics:
```
nic_tx_tail_mbps{host=\"rack-14-host2\"}=1280
kvcache_miss_rate{tenant=\"bench-x\"}=0.36
request_latency_p99{slice=\"dedicated-usw1-s20\"}=202ms
gpu_util=0.68
```

josh: that's a high kv miss. short-term steps: toggle tenant prefetch=false, evict best-effort batch, and apply nic egress shaper 20% on the hot host. long-term we need an automated policy so ops isn't manual every week.

rui: alternative mitigation we've prototyped: "mini-slab" assignment — when a tenant matches a noise fingerprint we carve a tiny reserved slab (1-2 GPUs) for that tenant for 24-72h to localize regen and avoid cross-tenant impact. It's cheaper than full dedicated and avoids repeated proxy spillback. We pair it with a small operational surcharge to reflect the overhead.

priya: interesting. what's the fingerprint signal for auto-trigger?

rui: propose fingerprint: kv_miss_rate > 0.25 AND nic_tx_tail > 900 Mbps over a 10m rolling window. When detected: 1) simulate fractional cost impact for 24h, 2) if sim OK, auto-assign mini-slab for 48h and set tenant-config prefetch=false, 3) increment a per-tenant noise_counter metric. If tenant recurs 3x in 30d escalate billing tier.

josh: how do we avoid accidentally escalating interactive customers? need to exclude tenants with SLA tag interactive-high. Also need a cold-start budget cap so mini-slab fill doesn't explode costs.

andrew: short-term ops actions: toggled prefetch=false for bench-x, applied nic_shaper 20% on rack-14-host2, evicted 10 best-effort pods. infra-bot: can you run a 24h sim for top-10 noisy tenants and post reserved delta?

infra-bot: running sim job now. expected ETA ~2h. will post results as a follow-up message. logs: action-applied prefetch=false tenant=bench-x; nic_shaper=20% host=rack-14-host2; evicted=10 pods.

priya: rollout plan if sim looks acceptable: (A) implement detector in telemetry pipeline, (B) add mini-slab allocator (24-72h leases), (C) add billing flag and surcharge plumbing, (D) canary: 5% of allocs in us-west1 for 48h. rollback if cold-start rate increases >15% or p99 for other tenants regresses.

rui: ops notes: mini-slab implementation needs guardrails: max concurrent mini-slabs per-rack, total mini-slab budget per-region, and preflight sim before allocation. Also expose opt-out for customers (self-managed) and an opt-in "self-noise-manage" that accepts surcharge but automates mitigation.

josh: tag @finance and @legal for billing/surcharge TOS; tag @product for SLA language. andrew keep monitor open for 2h and paste p99 trend. :thumbsup:
